definitions.explanation: A way through or along which people can walk. A path or walkway connecting two areas.
A walkway between rows of seats or shelves.

examples.japanese: この{通路|つうろ}は{暗|くら}くて{狭|せま}い。
examples.english: This passageway is dark and narrow.

examples.japanese: {地下|ちか}{通路|つうろ}で{駅|えき}まで{行|い}ける。
examples.english: You can get to the station through the underground passage.

examples.japanese: {非常|ひじょう}{通路|つうろ}を{確保|かくほ}してください。
examples.english: Please keep the emergency passage clear.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{裏|うら}に{通路|つうろ}があって、そこから{隣|となり}の{通|とお}りに{出|で}られる。
examples.english: There's a passageway behind the building, and you can get to the next street through it.

examples.japanese: {通路|つうろ}に{荷物|にもつ}を{置|お}かないでください。
examples.english: Please don't leave luggage in the aisle.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}の{通路|つうろ}{側|がわ}の{席|せき}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I reserved an aisle seat on the plane.
examples.notes: {通路|つうろ}{側|がわ} = aisle side

examples.japanese: スーパーの{通路|つうろ}で{知|し}り{合|あ}いに{会|あ}った。
examples.english: I ran into an acquaintance in the supermarket aisle.

examples.japanese: {映画館|えいがかん}では{暗|くら}くなる{前|まえ}に{通路|つうろ}を{通|とお}って{席|せき}に{着|つ}いた{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: At the movie theater, it's better to go down the aisle and sit down before it gets dark.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通路|つうろ}{側|がわ} (aisle side)
- {窓|まど}{側|がわ} (window side - opposite)
- {非常|ひじょう}{通路|つうろ} (emergency passage)
- {地下|ちか}{通路|つうろ} (underground passage)
- {通路|つうろ}を{塞|ふさ}ぐ (to block the aisle)

TRAVEL USAGE:
- {通路|つうろ}{側|がわ}の{席|せき} (aisle seat) vs {窓|まど}{側|がわ}の{席|せき} (window seat)

SAFETY:
- {避難|ひなん}{通路|つうろ} (evacuation route)
- {通路|つうろ}を{確保|かくほ}する (to secure passage)
